dimensions.measurement: Resolve every material factual claim to an admissible primary-source citation and exact source identity.
dimensions.full_credit: Uncited material claim count equals zero and every citation resolves to its recorded digest.
dimensions.zero_credit: At least one material claim is unsupported or cites only a generated summary.

dimensions.measurement: Compare inspected source classes and records with the declared research universe.
dimensions.full_credit: Coverage ratio equals one and all exclusions are explicitly recorded.
dimensions.zero_credit: The universe is undeclared or any included source class is unaccounted for.

dimensions.measurement: Count factual-sounding inferences or unknowns that are not labelled.
dimensions.full_credit: Unlabelled inference and unknown count equals zero.
dimensions.zero_credit: Any inference or unknown is presented as an inspected or recalled fact.

dimensions.measurement: Independently inspect the counterevidence and disagreement section for the scoped decision.
dimensions.full_credit: Every material disagreement is represented or the bounded search reports none with evidence.
dimensions.zero_credit: Counterevidence was not sought or contrary evidence was omitted.
